alt: A flow shows the original instructions naming GetCompanyValue, which does not exist in OpenTTD 13.4, so a script that calls it dies at that call and its company stops acting, while the fixed instructions and starter name GetQuarterlyCompanyValue, which exists, so the script keeps running; a note says the grader is unchanged and the starter scores 0 in both versions.
caption: The task told solvers to call a game function that does not exist, so the starter crashed at its first call to it; the fix changes the instructions and starter.
